shortDescription: A clipboard manager for Windows 11. Press Ctrl+Shift+V to see what you copied as cards, then search, pin and paste it. Keep prompts and snippets in collections. Free and open source, with history encrypted on your PC.
description:
Vstavka is a clipboard manager for Windows 11. It keeps a history of what you copy and shows it as cards in a panel at the bottom of your screen. Press Ctrl+Shift+V, choose a card and press Enter: Vstavka pastes it into the app you were using.

CLIPBOARD HISTORY YOU CAN SEE
• Text, links, color values, images and copied file paths
• Cards show a preview and the source app when available
• The last 500 items from the past 30 days by default; you decide how many to keep and for how long

FIND AND PASTE QUICKLY
• Search your history or filter it by type
• Pin the items you use often
• Move between cards with the arrow keys and paste with Enter
• Press Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 to paste a card by its position, or Shift+Enter to paste as plain text
• Record a different shortcut in Settings if another app already uses Ctrl+Shift+V

COLLECTIONS FOR PROMPTS AND SNIPPETS
• Keep prompts, snippets and other things you reuse in named, colored collections
• Collection items stay out of your everyday history and are kept until you remove them

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Your history stays on this PC and is encrypted for your Windows account
• There are no accounts, ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases, analytics or cloud sync
• Password managers are excluded by default, and you can add other apps
• Pause saving, delete individual items or clear your history in Settings

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light, dark and system themes, with six accent choices including the Windows accent
• Short, separate sounds for copy and paste, with volume control
• Interface in 24 languages, including right-to-left layouts
• Optional start when you sign in to Windows

Good to know: text is saved without formatting. File cards remember file paths, so the original files must still exist when you paste them. Automatic pasting follows Windows security restrictions; apps running as administrator may require a manual paste. Paste sounds for Ctrl+V and Shift+Insert indicate the shortcut, not confirmation that another app accepted the content.

Vstavka is free and open source. It requires Windows 11 on an x64 PC.
features: Clipboard history in a panel at the bottom of your screen
Open it with Ctrl+Shift+V or a shortcut you record
Paste the selected card into the app you were using
Preview text, links, colors, images, and copied file paths
See source app icons where available
Search your history and filter it by type
Keep prompts and snippets in named, colored collections
Navigate and paste with the keyboard, including Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9
Paste as plain text with Shift+Enter
Local history encrypted for your Windows account
No accounts, ads, analytics, or cloud sync
Pause saving, exclude apps, and manage history retention
Separate copy and paste sounds with volume controls
Light, dark, and system themes with a Windows accent option
Optional startup when you sign in to Windows
whatsNew: The new cross-platform interface comes to Windows. It includes a refreshed clipboard panel and a setup guide where you can record and try your own shortcut. Your saved history, collections and preferences carry over when you update.
recommendedHardware: Audio output for copy and paste sounds
